definition: In a resolved kit, the style a slot's value was taken from: the style itself, or the ancestor up its cascade that settled the slot. It shows which decisions are the style's own and which it inherits.
basis: VISION.md, the bindings: a kit resolves "with a source column showing which ancestor each value came from". build/resolve_kit.py "prints the result with the ancestor each binding came from", and with it "Tidewater Georgian is twenty-one local decisions on top of sixty-odd inherited ones".
sense: the ancestor a kit value came from
